name: Nandha Kumar B K
title: Full Stack Developer
tagline: I build and maintain e-commerce storefronts and Salesforce applications. Right now I'm at CDW Technologies, working on Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
description: Nandha Kumar B K is a full stack developer in Chennai working on e-commerce platforms and Salesforce.
summary: I'm a full stack developer with over three years of experience building web applications, mostly e-commerce platforms and Salesforce solutions. I work on both the frontend and the backend, and I'm comfortable with API integrations, databases and the architecture that ties them together.
I like turning business requirements into working features, owning them from the first conversation through to production, and keeping the code easy to maintain.

roles.title: SFCC Developer
roles.project: Retail e-commerce and rental site for winter sports gear
bullets: Sole offshore developer on the project, working directly with client stakeholders on requirements, technical discussions, issue triage and delivery.
Helped rebuild the main pages of the rental flow (Gear, Renters, Payment and Store Landing) with a focus on performance and a smoother path from gear selection to payment.
Built reservation check-in by integrating the client's existing API, so customers can look up reservations made at the POS, verify their rental and check in on the storefront.
Built a kids' rental package feature covering frontend and backend logic, and added ADA accessibility fixes across several storefront pages.

roles.title: Salesforce Developer
roles.project: Enterprise CRM for a supply chain solutions company
bullets: Built features across opportunity management, quote generation and sales operations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows and admin configuration.
Designed an LWC search and filter interface for millions of opportunity records, with configurable filters for different data types. Phase 2 added shareable bookmarked searches and Excel export.
Owned key parts of a product management feature that imports thousands of product records from CSV, using job-based batch processing for reliability at volume.
Built single and bulk product matching for N-series part numbers through Oracle APIs, and worked with the solution architect on load testing and performance fixes.
Built sales team creation flows with Flows and Apex, dynamic report filters and other automations, and handled production debugging.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
